item.title: Count a game day you forgot to post
item.summary: Did the task but never checked in? Tell Murph in your game chat. It asks what you want your post to say, then counts that missed day.
item.details: The post is your own words, and the other players see it like any written check-in. It works for your own days that have already closed, and you can ask Murph to take it back. Games that require a photo or heart-rate check-in still need one.
